title: FY 2025 Consolidated Annual Report on UAP (AARO, 20 Jul 2026)
doc_notes: This document is the FY 2025 Consolidated Annual Report on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena produced by the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO).

incidents.summary: U.S. Navy assets operating off the coast of Virginia reported approximately 100 airborne UAP and two likely uncrewed surface systems.
incidents.quote: The report described approximately 100 airborne UAP and two, likely uncrewed, surface systems.
